turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello, thank you for having me.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: A Linux server is suddenly very slow. Walk me through how you would find out why.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would start with top and uptime to see the load and which process uses the CPU. Then then I check memory and swap, because heavy swapping makes everything slow. Also, i look at disk space and disk io with df and iostat. Finally, finally I read the logs and ask what changed recently, such as a deploy or update.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: A VM in a private subnet cannot reach the internet. How do you find the cause?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: First I check the route table of the subnet. Then then outbound security group and network ACL rules. Also, a private subnet needs a NAT gateway for outbound internet access. Finally, from the VM I test with curl, traceroute and a DNS lookup.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: You are first on call and a major outage alert fires. What are your first ten minutes?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I acknowledge the alert and assess who is affected and how badly. Then i communicate early and open an incident channel for stakeholders. Also, i mitigate first, for example by rolling back, and find the root cause afterwards. Finally, i keep a timeline and hold a blameless post incident review.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: Tell me about a time you dealt with an upset customer.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The situation was an outage that left a customer without their service for an hour. My task was to restore it and keep them informed. I acknowledged their frustration, explained the cause in plain words, and gave an update every fifteen minutes. The result was that service came back and the customer thanked us in writing.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: To check on-call availability, can you work the evening rota like everyone else?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, I am happy to be on the rota.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: Great, thank you. That is all from me.
